kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنحرف (form VII)
# أَنْحَرِفُ (ʔanḥarifu) /ʔan.ħa.ri.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# أَنْحَرِفَ (ʔanḥarifa) /ʔan.ħa.ri.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# أَنْحَرِفْ (ʔanḥarif) /ʔan.ħa.rif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
